# AlloyDB Omni

Skills that teach agents to work with AlloyDB Omni. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [gemini-cli-extensions/alloydb-omni](https://github.com/gemini-cli-extensions/alloydb-omni), at commit `37101e3`.

Create, connect, and interact with an AlloyDB Omni database and data.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **AlloyDB Omni**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **AlloyDB Omni**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install alloydb-omni@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

2 skills: `alloydb-omni-container`, `alloydb-omni-kubernetes`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.

The skills mention these environment variables for credentials: `DATABASE_PASSWORD`, `POSTGRES_PASSWORD`. This plugin does not store them.

## Docs

- Vendor repository: https://github.com/gemini-cli-extensions/alloydb-omni
